G.A., Rajeev Kumar Singh 
Ramjeet vs State Of U.P. And Another on 7 November, 2025

Court No. - 77
 Hon'Ble Saurabh Srivastava, J.

1. Heard Sri Abhay Pratap Singh, learned counsel for the applicant, Sri Vinay Kumar Singh,
Advocate holding brief of Sri Rajeev Kumar Singh, learned counsel for the opposite party no.2 and
learned A.G.A. for State.
2.

The instant application has been preferred for challenging the impugned charge-sheet dated
21.09.2024 and cognizance/summoning order dated 15.04.2025 as well as the entire proceedings of
Case No.24756 of 2025 (State vs. Ramjeet) arising out of Case Crime No.300 of 2024, under
sections 419, 420, 504, 506 Ipc, P.S. Cantt., District- Gorakhpur, pending before learned court of
Chief Judicial Magistrate, Gorakhpur.

3. On the back drop of registration of FIR, wherein the applicant has been implicated as an accused with specific allegation that applicant preferred fabricated, forged and fictitious documents by way of showing himself as son of Kamla and demonstrated through some fictitious documents, i.e.,
informant being son of Kammal.

After conducting detail investigation, charge-sheet has been submitted by concerned Investigating Officer, whereupon cognizance of offence has been taken up by learned court concerned vide order dated 15.04.2025.

4. Being aggrieved with the cognizance of offence taken up by learned court concerned in respect of sections 419, 420, 504, 506 IPC, the instant application has been preferred at the behest of applicant challenging the entire proceeding, which includes the charge-sheet dated 21.09.2024 along with cognizance of offence/summoning order dated 15.04.2025 also.

5. Earlier, during the course of argument as raised by learned counsel for applicant, certain time had been sought for filing supplementary affidavit and the same was extended by this Court and posted the matter for another date.

Thereafter, learned counsel for the applicant preferred supplementary affidavit on dated 16.10.2025, through which an order dated 30.09.2025 passed by Settlement Officer Consolidation has been preferred, through which certain aspect along with evidentiary proof available in the revenue records have been discussed and lastly it has been held during consolidation proceeding that there is hardly any ground available in favour of Jagannath (opposite party no.2) for seeking correction of his father?s name in place of Kammal.

It is admitted fact at the behest of opposite party no.2 that order dated 30.09.2025 has not been challenged before Deputy Director of Consolidation and as such order dated 30.09.2025 passed by Settlement Officer Consolidation is holding the field as on today.
6.

Learned counsel for the opposite party no.2 was having no ground to support the stand whatsoever has been taken up through narration of the FIR, which culminated into submission of charge-sheet by concerned Investigating Officer, whereupon cognizance of offence has been taken Ramjeet vs State Of U.P. And Another on 7 November, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/100006973/
2 up by learned court concerned in respect of order dated 30.09.2025 passed by Settlement Officer Consolidation, District Gorakhpur.

sentences.text: 7. In view of aforementioned facts and circumstances of the case, the controversy as raised at the behest of opposite party no.2 against the applicant by way of specific stand and allegation for using name of his father as Kamla, is having no illegality.

8. In view of above, the entire proceeding of Case No.24756 of 2025 (State vs. Ramjeet) arising out of Case Crime No.300 of 2024, under sections 419, 420, 504, 506 IPC, P.S. Cantt., District- Gorakhpur, pending before learned court of Chief Judicial Magistrate, Gorakhpur, including charge-sheet dated 21.09.2024 and cognizance/summoning order dated 15.04.2025, are hereby set-aside.
9. The instant application stands allowed accordingly.
